intro.sr: Klijent kupuje bez ikakve registracije: bira proizvod u prodavnici, upisuje podatke na naplati, a sistem sam pravi nalog u pozadini. Pokazane su dve kupovine (druga sa kuponom) - svaka sa novim gostom, pa se automatsko pravljenje naloga dešava oba puta.
intro.en: A customer buys with no registration at all: picks a product in the shop, enters their details at checkout and the system creates an account in the background. Two purchases are shown (the second with a coupon) - each with a new guest, so the automatic account creation happens both times.

otvaranje-prvog-proizvoda.sr: U listi proizvoda {kliknemo} na prvi proizvod.
otvaranje-prvog-proizvoda.en: In the product list we {click} the first product.

dodavanje-u-korpu-1.sr: {Kliknemo} „Dodaj u korpu“ - sistem odmah otvara korpu.
dodavanje-u-korpu-1.en: We {click} “Dodaj u korpu” - the system opens the cart straight away.

prelazak-na-naplatu-1.sr: U korpi {kliknemo} „Nastavi na naplatu“. Nismo prijavljeni - sistem to naglašava i objašnjava da će nalog biti napravljen automatski.
prelazak-na-naplatu-1.en: In the cart we {click} “Nastavi na naplatu”. We are not logged in - the system points that out and explains that an account will be created automatically.

email-potvrde-1.sr: Link iz email poruke finalizuje porudžbinu (ovde simulirano direktnim otvaranjem linka).
email-potvrde-1.en: The link from the confirmation email finalizes the order (simulated here by opening the link directly).

otvaranje-drugog-proizvoda.sr: Za drugu kupovinu ponovo {kliknemo} „Prodavnica“ i biramo drugi proizvod iz liste.
otvaranje-drugog-proizvoda.en: For the second purchase we {click} “Prodavnica” again and pick the second product from the list.

dodavanje-u-korpu-2.en: We {click} “Dodaj u korpu” - the system opens the cart.

prelazak-na-naplatu-2.en: In the cart we {click} “Nastavi na naplatu”.

primena-kupona-2.sr: Upisujemo kod kupona i {kliknemo} dugme za primenu - odmah se vidi umanjen iznos.
primena-kupona-2.en: We type the coupon code and {click} the apply button - the reduced amount shows immediately.

email-potvrde-2.sr: Link iz email poruke finalizuje i drugu porudžbinu.
email-potvrde-2.en: The email link finalizes the second order as well.

unos-podataka-kao-gost-1.sr: Ništa nije unapred popunjeno - upisujemo ime, prezime, email, telefon i adresu dostave.
unos-podataka-kao-gost-1.en: Nothing is pre-filled - we type the first name, last name, email, phone and delivery address.

nalog-automatski-kreiran-1.sr: U pozadini je sistem napravio pravi korisnički nalog za ovaj email - klijent to nije morao da traži.
nalog-automatski-kreiran-1.en: In the background the system has created a real user account for this email - the customer did not have to ask for it.

unos-podataka-kao-gost-2.sr: Drugi gost, drugi email - upisujemo sve podatke ispočetka.
unos-podataka-kao-gost-2.en: A second guest with a different email - again we type all the details from scratch.

nalog-automatski-kreiran-2.sr: I za drugi email sistem sam pravi nalog.
nalog-automatski-kreiran-2.en: For the second email the system creates an account on its own too.
